description: A band's concert history, newest first — use this for "what did Radiohead play at their most recent show". Pass `artist_name` and the band is resolved to its MusicBrainz ID for you, preferring an exact name match so a tribute act does not answer for the band; pass `mbid` directly when you have one. Returns setlists with date, venue, city, and full track lists.

artist_name.description: Band or performer name, e.g. "Radiohead". Either this or mbid is required.

mbid.description: MusicBrainz ID. Either this or artist_name is required.

p.description: Page number, 1-based. Page 1 is the most recent concerts.

name: artist_setlists
